'''Laerad''' was an [[Aiel]] from the [[Moshaine]] [[Shaido]]. He was a ''[[Duadhe Mahdi'in]]''.

== Appearance ==
He was grizzled.

== Activities ==
He, with part of his sept are dispersed through a [[Gateway]] near the [[Plains of Maredo]]. He runs to [[Maeric]] with the news that a huge force of Aiel are coming towards them. His clan engages the enemy and he probably didn't survive the exchange.
